subject: Redeem sandbox allowance & invoice offset - Novatech
messages:
From: Sunny Li <sunny.li@novatech.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 9 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Redeem sandbox allowance and offset May invoice

Hi Irene / Laura,

Hope you both had a good weekend. Quick ask from our end: we used up the Novatech sandbox allowance in April and would like to redeem the unused portion as a credit to offset the May 2027 invoice (INV-2027-0532). Can Redwood provide a credit memo and confirm whether the offset will be applied as an invoice credit (reducing the receivable) or as a post-bill promotional allowance?

What Novatech can provide now: PO# 45321 and a short note from procurement confirming the sandbox usage details (attaching PO).

We prefer an invoice-level credit if possible (easier for our AR team). If you need anything else from our side to complete internal accounting, let me know.

Thanks,
Sunny Li
Director, Procurement | Novatech Inc.
Attachments: Novatech_PO_45321.pdf
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Sunny Li <sunny.li@novatech.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Redeem sandbox allowance and offset May invoice

Hi Sunny —

Thanks for the PO and the clear ask. We can issue a credit memo to offset INV-2027-0532. Two quick internal items I need to align on and will copy finance:

- Confirmation of credit amount that Novatech expects to apply (can you confirm the $ amount tied to the sandbox usage? current estimate on your side should suffice).
- Whether you want the credit as an immediate invoice offset (applied to INV-2027-0532) or as a proforma allowance to be recognized over Q2.

I’m attaching a draft credit memo for Novatech so you can confirm language/amount. Once Novatech confirms amount, I’ll route to Finance for GLA mapping and the actual issuance.

Attachment: CreditMemo_Novatech_DRAFT.pdf

Action items: 
- Sunny: confirm credit amount and choice of invoice offset vs allowance
- Karthik / Marcus (cc’d): can you confirm preferred GLA and posting approach for a one-time promotional credit for a partner pilot?

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Revenue Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
+1 (415) 555-0191
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Redeem sandbox allowance and offset May invoice

Irene / Laura —

Thanks for the context. Guidance from Accounting below (summarized):

- If Novatech wants an immediate invoice-level reduction (preferred by customer): issue a credit memo and apply it to INV-2027-0532. Accounting treatment: reduce AR and reduce revenue recognized for the invoice period. Use contra-revenue GLA 4102 (Customer Credits / Contra Revenue) for the credit memo. Journal (simplified):
  - Dr: Sales Returns & Allowances (GLA 4102) 
  - Cr: Accounts Receivable (AR)

- If Redwood prefers to treat the sandbox redemption as a marketing/promotion expense (recognized over Q2): process as a promotional allowance. Use expense GLA 6405 (Promotions & Trials). Journal:
  - Dr: Promotions Expense (GLA 6405)
  - Cr: Promotional Liability / Credit Reserve (GLA 2199)

From an audit / ASC 606 standpoint, invoice offset is cleaner for a one-off customer credit tied to a billed invoice. For internal reporting, we should note it as a one-time adjustment and include supporting docs.

Marcus: please confirm if one-time credit up to $12,000 is approvable without escalated review.

- Karthik
Finance | Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Sunny Li <sunny.li@novatech.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 08:38:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Redeem sandbox allowance and offset May invoice

Sunny — looping you in with finance guidance. Novatech prefers invoice-level offset (confirmed verbally). We expect the credit to be for $8,400 (per our usage log).

Marcus — can you approve a one-time credit memo for $8,400 to be applied to INV-2027-0532 and authorize accounting to post the AR reduction to GLA 4102? If approved, I will:
- Finalize credit memo language and amounts (use attached draft)
- Route to Accounting for posting and to CS for HubSpot deal close notes
- Request a signed confirmation from Novatech for their records

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Acct Exec, Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Sunny Li <sunny.li@novatech.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Redeem sandbox allowance and offset May invoice

Folks — approved.

Approval details: one-time credit memo for $8,400 to be applied against INV-2027-0532. Accounting should post as an invoice-level credit (contra-revenue) using GLA 4102. Please ensure the following before close:

- Final credit memo PDF (signed by Redwood rep) uploaded to Drive and attached to the AR ticket.
- HubSpot deal NT-2027-143 updated with credit memo ID and note: \"Sandbox allowance redemption applied 2027-05-11\".
- Customer confirmation email saved in the AR folder.

Routing notes for Accounting (Karthik): please post the AR clearing entry and then create the offset journal in the May close. Mark it as one-time promotional adjustment for audit.

Irene / Laura: once accounting confirms posting, please share posting reference and HubSpot link with Sunny so Novatech can reconcile.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
